name: 考研词书
description: 考研英语高频核心词汇

example.en: Everyone must abide by the law.
example.cn: 人人都必须遵守法律。

example.en: Opportunities abound in this field.
example.cn: 这个领域机会众多。

example.en: He abstained from voting.
example.cn: 他投票时弃权了。

example.en: The novel won critical acclaim.
example.cn: 这部小说赢得了评论界的赞誉。

example.en: He became a coffee addict during exams.
example.cn: 考试期间他成了咖啡上瘾者。

example.en: The building has great aesthetic value.
example.cn: 这座建筑有很高的审美价值。

example.en: The aggregate score was 4-2.
example.cn: 总比分为4比2。

example.en: We spent the day in agreeable weather.
example.cn: 我们在宜人的天气里度过了一天。

example.en: Align the text to the center.
example.cn: 将文本居中对齐。

example.en: Each student was allotted ten minutes.
example.cn: 每位学生被分配了十分钟。

example.en: The city has a unique allure.
example.cn: 这座城市有种独特的魅力。

example.en: Nothing can alter his decision.
example.cn: 什么都改变不了他的决定。

example.en: She amassed a fortune in ten years.
example.cn: 她十年间积累了财富。

example.en: There is ample time to prepare.
example.cn: 有充足的时间来准备。

example.en: The letter caused him great anguish.
example.cn: 这封信使他极为痛苦。

example.en: Her words animated the whole team.
example.cn: 她的话让整个团队充满活力。

example.en: There was open antagonism between the two groups.
example.cn: 两组之间公开对抗。

example.en: Voter apathy worried the officials.
example.cn: 选民的冷漠令官员们担忧。

example.en: The manager gave an honest appraisal of the work.
example.cn: 经理对这项工作做了坦诚的评价。

example.en: She felt apprehensive about the results.
example.cn: 她对结果感到担心。

example.en: He is an ardent supporter of the team.
example.cn: 他是这支球队的热心支持者。

example.en: The climb was long and arduous.
example.cn: 这次攀登漫长而艰辛。

example.en: His arrogant attitude cost him friends.
example.cn: 他傲慢的态度使他失去了朋友。

example.en: She has aspirations to study abroad.
example.cn: 她有出国留学的抱负。

example.en: He asserted his innocence firmly.
example.cn: 他坚定地声明自己无罪。

example.en: She attributes her success to luck.
example.cn: 她把成功归因于运气。

example.en: He augmented his income by tutoring.
example.cn: 他通过做家教增加收入。

example.en: This is an authoritative report on climate.
example.cn: 这是一份关于气候的权威报告。

example.en: They gazed at the canyon in awe.
example.cn: 他们敬畏地凝视着峡谷。

example.en: The question baffled the whole class.
example.cn: 这个问题难住了全班。

example.en: Members cast their ballots by mail.
example.cn: 成员们通过邮寄投票。

example.en: A grand banquet was held for the guests.
example.cn: 为宾客举行了盛大的宴会。

example.en: She barely passed the driving test.
example.cn: 她勉强通过了驾照考试。

example.en: Farmers bartered grain for tools.
example.cn: 农民用粮食换取工具。

example.en: The factory produces a new batch every week.
example.cn: 工厂每周生产一批新产品。

example.en: What he said has no bearing on the case.
example.cn: 他说的话与本案无关。

example.en: Please book the tickets beforehand.
example.cn: 请提前订票。

example.en: The title was bestowed on the scientist.
example.cn: 这一头衔被授予了这位科学家。

example.en: The map bewildered the tourists.
example.cn: 这张地图把游客弄糊涂了。

example.en: The report was criticized for bias.
example.cn: 这篇报道因偏见受到批评。

example.en: They wore bizarre costumes to the party.
example.cn: 他们穿着奇装异服去参加聚会。

example.en: A small blunder caused a big delay.
example.cn: 一个小失误造成了严重延误。

example.en: To be blunt, the plan needs revision.
example.cn: 坦率地说，这个计划需要修改。

example.en: New evidence bolstered the argument.
example.cn: 新证据增强了这个论点。

example.en: Consumers boycotted the company's products.
example.cn: 消费者抵制了该公司的产品。

example.en: Sharing the data was a breach of trust.
example.cn: 共享这些数据违背了信任。

example.en: Stop brooding over past mistakes.
example.cn: 别再为过去的错误闷闷不乐。

example.en: Trees act as a buffer against the wind.
example.cn: 树木起到挡风缓冲的作用。

example.en: The bulk of the work is already done.
example.cn: 大部分工作已经完成。

example.en: The market bustles with shoppers at noon.
example.cn: 中午市场里购物者熙熙攘攘。

example.en: Take the road to bypass the city center.
example.cn: 走这条路绕开市中心。

example.en: The university attracts students of high caliber.
example.cn: 这所大学吸引高水准的学生。

example.en: Thank you for your candid advice.
example.cn: 感谢你坦率的建议。

example.en: The photo caption was written by the editor.
example.cn: 照片说明由编辑撰写。

example.en: The film was censored before release.
example.cn: 这部电影上映前经过了审查。

example.en: The census is conducted every ten years.
example.cn: 人口普查每十年进行一次。

example.en: The crowd chanted the player's name.
example.cn: 人群反复呼喊这名球员的名字。

example.en: Bright colors characterize her paintings.
example.cn: 鲜艳的色彩是她的画作的特点。

example.en: A huge chunk of the budget goes to salaries.
example.cn: 预算的一大部分用于工资。

example.en: They found a way to circumvent the rules.
example.cn: 他们找到了规避规则的途径。

example.en: The city clamped down on illegal parking.
example.cn: 该市严查违章停车。

example.en: She clasped the old photo tightly.
example.cn: 她紧紧握着那张旧照片。

example.en: The concert reached its climax at midnight.
example.cn: 音乐会在午夜达到高潮。

example.en: Wet clothes cling to the body.
example.cn: 湿衣服紧贴在身上。

example.en: Turn the knob clockwise to open it.
example.cn: 顺时针旋动手柄即可打开。

example.en: A cluster of stars shone above.
example.cn: 头顶上一簇星星闪烁着。

example.en: He clutched the rope with both hands.
example.cn: 他双手紧紧抓住绳子。

example.en: The two parties formed a coalition.
example.cn: 两党组成了联盟。

example.en: She gave a coherent explanation of the theory.
example.cn: 她对这一理论作了条理清晰的解释。

example.en: The town retains colonial architecture.
example.cn: 这座小镇保留着殖民时期建筑。

example.en: Oil is a major commodity in world trade.
example.cn: 石油是世界贸易中的主要商品。

example.en: Electric cars are now commonplace.
example.cn: 电动汽车如今已司空见惯。

example.en: Put your luggage in the overhead compartment.
example.cn: 把行李放到头顶的行李舱。

example.en: The software is compatible with all systems.
example.cn: 该软件与所有系统兼容。

example.en: The evidence compelled him to admit the truth.
example.cn: 证据迫使他承认了真相。

example.en: Never be complacent about safety.
example.cn: 对安全问题绝不能掉以轻心。

example.en: The complexity of the issue surprised us.
example.cn: 这个问题的复杂性让我们吃惊。

example.en: Trust is a key component of friendship.
example.cn: 信任是友谊的重要组成部分。

example.en: The committee comprises nine experts.
example.cn: 该委员会由九位专家组成。

example.en: Both sides made compromises to end the dispute.
example.cn: 双方都做出了妥协以结束争端。

example.en: She could hardly conceal her excitement.
example.cn: 她几乎掩饰不住自己的兴奋。

example.en: He conceded that the plan had failed.
example.cn: 他承认计划失败了。

example.en: The university conferred an honorary degree on her.
example.cn: 大学授予她荣誉学位。

example.en: New lanes eased traffic congestion.
example.cn: 新车道缓解了交通拥堵。

example.en: Friends consoled her after the loss.
example.cn: 失利后朋友们安慰了她。

example.en: Events seemed to conspire against us.
example.cn: 种种事情仿佛都在跟我们作对。

example.en: Hydrogen is a constituent of water.
example.cn: 氢是水的组成成分。

example.en: Limited funds constrained the research.
example.cn: 有限的资金限制了这项研究。

example.en: He showed contempt for flattery.
example.cn: 他对阿谀奉承表示蔑视。

example.en: Scholars contend that the theory is flawed.
example.cn: 学者们主张该理论有缺陷。

example.en: The new policy is highly controversial.
example.cn: 新政策极具争议。

example.en: The two rivers converge near the valley.
example.cn: 两条河在山谷附近交汇。

example.en: She works in corporate finance.
example.cn: 她在公司金融部门工作。

example.en: Salt water corrodes metal quickly.
example.cn: 盐水会很快腐蚀金属。

example.en: Exercise can counteract stress.
example.cn: 运动可以抵消压力。

example.en: The staff were courteous and helpful.
example.cn: 员工礼貌而热心。

example.en: The event received wide media coverage.
example.cn: 这一事件得到了媒体的广泛报道。

example.en: She is a credible witness.
example.cn: 她是一位可信的证人。

example.en: It was a deliberate choice, not an accident.
example.cn: 这是深思熟虑的选择，并非意外。

example.en: Reading cultivates the mind.
example.cn: 阅读能陶冶心智。
